name: MN-07
label: Safe R

key_factors: No polls or expert ratings; markets price ~4% for Osberg
model.rationale: The R+18 baseline, Fischbach's incumbency, and her dominant fundraising advantage leave no evidence pointing toward an upset, and prediction markets give Osberg only about a 4% chance.
model.watch: A late, unexpected polling series showing the race inside single digits would be the main signal to revisit.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
MN-07 is a heavily Republican-leaning rural district, and incumbent Michelle Fischbach is running for reelection after being renominated. She has raised about $1.29 million and holds roughly $920,000 on hand, while Democratic challenger Erik Osberg has raised about $335,000 with $114,000 available. No outside spending of note has appeared on either side.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings exist for this race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, money, and prediction markets, which price Fischbach's win probability at roughly 94%. The combination of the district's strong Republican lean, incumbency, and financial advantage points to a comfortable Republican hold, with modest residual uncertainty from the absence of polling.
